newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Midas in HK$16 mln share placement.
newsitem.headline: Midas in HK$16 mln share placement.

text.p: Midas Printing Group Ltd said it would raise net proceeds of about HK$16 million to be used for additional working capital through placement of 18.5 million new shares to controlling shareholder ERI Holdings Ltd.

Midas said ERI had agreed to place 18.5 million existing shares, or 8.46 percent of Midas, at HK$0.91 each to independent investors before subscribing the same amount of new shares at a price equivalent to the net placing price after expenses.
ERI's stake in Midas will be diluted to 40.23 percent after the deal from 43.63 percent, the statement said.
ERI is jointly owned by Midas directors Lau Chuk-kin, Wan Siu-kau, Tang Yue-nien and Fung Hong-hung.
Midas shares were down HK$0.03 to HK$0.97 in early trade on Friday.
